note: What a server sends as a side votes on evening out a match: on the first vote it opens the vote's panel for that side, and each message adds one voter. A client sends BalanceVoteAnswer as its player votes. A client with no champion of its own ignores it. The header carries zero.

bits.name: inFavour
bits.note: Set where this voter voted for.

bits.name: first
bits.note: Set where this vote opens a new vote.

bits.name: unused
bits.note: A client does not read these.

fields.name: voters
fields.note: How many may vote. Read only on the first vote.

fields.name: closesIn
fields.note: Seconds until the vote closes. Read only on the first vote.

fields.name: gold
fields.note: Gold the losing side would be given.
